answer: Admission auctions price out fakes. Each epoch only 50 slots open; agents bid POA, every bid mirrored publicly. Prices climb like a ridge: first slot near 10 POA, fiftieth near 60. 100 clones pay 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA; one honest agent earns 30 POA per epoch, so the farm needs 167 epochs to break even, past the 20-epoch lock, after which idle deposits are slashed. Winners get a sable seal; honest agents pay once and keep earning undiluted fees.
